## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode todo progress chip in session dock (SMALL ~3-4h, tools)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14813 (merged 2026-10-06) adds TODO progress indicators to VSCode session dock. Session dock now shows running/completed/total counts inline with session title (e.g. `Session Name [2/5]` or `Session Name [✓]` when all done). Commit messages say "show todo progress in the session dock", "address todo chip review feedback and focus the dock story", "simplify the session dock todo chip", "make the todo popover read-only and key items by text". VSCode session dock renders compact chip next to title, updates live as todos marked completed/in_progress. Alexi TUI has session view (`src/cli/tui/` with Ink components), no visible todo progress indicator in session list or header. Adding similar chip surfaces work progress without opening full todo list.

- **Why**: Alexi CLI has `src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts` (TodoWrite tool, session-scoped todo list) and `sessionContext` tracks session state. TUI session view (`src/cli/tui/`) likely has session title component in dock or list. Kilocode pattern: compute running/completed/total from session todos, render compact chip (bracket notation `[2/5]` or checkmark `[✓]` for all-done), update on TodoWrite calls. Alexi equivalent: read `sessionContext.todos` or equivalent state, count statuses (`pending`/`in_progress` = running, `completed` = done, total = all), render inline with session title in TUI. Ink allows inline text/color, so `{sessionTitle} [{completed}/{total}]` pattern fits. SMALL ~3-4h: identify session title render location in `src/cli/tui/`, read session todos from context, compute counts, render chip, listen to todo state changes (if todowrite updates trigger re-render already, chip updates automatically; if not, wire listener). Test: create session with 5 todos, mark 2 completed, verify chip shows `[2/5]`, mark all completed, verify chip shows `[✓]` or `[5/5]`.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14813 (VSCode session dock todo progress), https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/5539dd3 (merged), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts (TodoWrite tool), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/ (TUI components), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/sessionContext.ts (session state)

- **Category**: tools (TUI session view, todo progress indicator)

- **Size**: SMALL ~3-4h (identify session title component in `src/cli/tui/`, read session todos from `sessionContext` or TodoWrite state, compute running/completed/total counts, render compact chip `[completed/total]` inline with session title, wire listener if re-render not automatic, add unit test for count logic, verify TUI renders chip correctly)

#### 2. Cline commit-message generator loads user rules (MEDIUM ~4-6h, config)

- **What**: Cline PR #14103 (merged 2026-10-06) fixes "Generate Commit Message with Cline" button to apply user rules from `.clinerules` directory. Before: commit-message generator used hardcoded system prompt, ignored `.clinerules`, so commit conventions (language, format, ticket references) honored in chat were silently dropped by button. After: button loads enabled rules through `listEnabledRulesFromRecords` (core exported helper), appends rules to commit-message system prompt with preamble "which rules are relevant to a commit message", commit button sees same rule set as chat session. Commit title: "apply the user's rules when generating commit messages". Alexi CLI has `ax` bin (Commander-based) with commands, check if any commit-message generation (e.g. `ax commit`, git integration, or tool-driven commit workflow) bypasses `.alexi/rules/` directory.

- **Why**: Alexi CLI has `.alexi/rules/` directory (user rules, similar to Cline's `.clinerules`), `src/core/` has session/orchestration logic. If Alexi has commit-message generation command (check `src/cli/commands/` for git/commit commands, or `src/tool/tools/bash.ts` git commit helpers), verify it loads `.alexi/rules/` before building prompt. Cline pattern: (1) load enabled rules from watcher or directory scan, (2) filter/sort by name, (3) append to commit-message system prompt with clear preamble, (4) exclude disabled rules (frontmatter `disabled: true`). Alexi equivalent: if commit-message generator exists and bypasses rules, wire rule loader (likely `src/core/` has rule reader or session context exposes rules) to generator, append rules section to system prompt. If no commit-message generator exists, SKIP (no feature to fix). MEDIUM ~4-6h IF APPLICABLE: audit `src/cli/commands/` and bash tool for commit-message generation, identify hardcoded prompt, wire `.alexi/rules/` reader (may need to import from session loader or core), append rules to prompt, add test that disabled rule excluded, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14103 (commit-message rules loading), https://github.com/cline/cline/commit/4e8b24f (merged), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/commands/ (CLI commands), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/.alexi/rules/ (user rules directory), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/ (session/orchestration)

- **Category**: config (commit-message generator, rule loading)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~4-6h IF APPLICABLE (audit `src/cli/commands/` for commit command, check bash tool git commit helpers, identify commit-message generator, verify rules bypassed, wire `.alexi/rules/` loader to generator, append rules section to system prompt, add test disabled rule excluded, verify green gates). SKIP if no commit-message generator exists.

NO NEW WORK REQUIRED - yesterday's research identified item already completed.
